purpose: Independent QAPG one-factor sensitivity analysis; no backlog-budget operating-point selection
deduplication: The reference configuration belongs to all four grids and is executed once per seed. Each grid varies only its stated parameter from the reference; the bandwidth grid also scales noise power to retain fixed PSD.
input_sharing: Original make_arrivals and generate_channels functions; arrivals shared for each beta/seed, channels shared for each M/seed. Thus V and bandwidth variants with common beta,M,seed receive identical input arrays. No new channel or arrival generator.
server_count_interpretation: M changes the number of18GHz servers, their original geometric positions, the available destination set, and the controller-defined M/N queue weight together. This is a system-size sensitivity, not an isolated causal experiment on capacity alone.
bandwidth_interpretation: noise_w=5e-17*bandwidth_hz. Fixed noise PSD rather than fixed total receiver noise; every active uplink receives the specified independently provisioned bandwidth.
other_configuration: All remaining SimConfig fields retain their original defaults. QAPG uses its existing fixed V controller and the common useful-work CPU correction. No controller parameter is tuned or changed.
statistics: All saved metrics use slots300 through2999 unless explicitly named full-run. Report arithmetic means and sample SD across five seed-level metrics. Do not treat slots as independent replicates. Local/edge processing shares are means of seed-level ratios. Runtime is diagnostic and machine-dependent.
failure_and_retention: Keep every prespecified configuration, seed and failure; no filtering or replacement. A failed run remains a failed record. No changes to prior comparison data, controller sources, or selected operating points.
required_validation: protocol/source freeze precedes all inputs and trajectories
energy components and total backlog sums
means and sample SD over five seeds
